title: 第四章 与他各取所需
slug: 和情敌共感后傲娇竹马火葬场了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

薄璟琛第一反应，便是尝试将自己从荒谬的触觉中抽离。

可注意力愈发涣散，那些感觉却愈发浓烈。

眼前，甚至还出现了少女凑近的脸颊。

垂敛的秾长眼睫，根根分明。

这双眼，他再熟悉不过了。

真的是夏暮！

那古板无趣的女人，怎么可能会这么主动地吻他？

他真是疯了，怎么会出现这种画面？！

“璟琛？你怎么了？记者在等你回话呢......”唤回他理智的，是苏苒错愕的惊呼。

薄璟琛在这种问题面前沉默，俨然是当众给了她响亮的一记耳光！

可下一秒，魂不守舍的薄璟琛，更是做出了出乎预料的举动。

他一言未发，转身，离开。

现场倏然陷入了一片控制不住的混乱中。

主持人尖叫着去扶苏苒，摄影师手忙脚乱地调整机位。

助理冲上前，挡住了直播的镜头。

“别拍了！”

“关掉！快关掉直播！”

苏苒被几个保镖簇拥着回到了个人休息室。

全程，她眼眶泛红，却还死撑着没有落下泪来，只是用一种难以置信的目光，死死盯着薄璟琛的背影。

薄璟琛摔上休息室的大门，还傻站在原地。

指尖死死捏成拳，久久没能回神。

耳畔满是方才脑海中，自动出现的少女低喘声。

所有的嘈杂声，仿佛被隔绝在了一层结界之外。

那种感受，只是很短的刹那，转瞬即逝。

可他的心口，却像是被人狠狠击中了般，燥热得喘不过气。

即便他很不愿意承认，但他也无法否认。

自己居然很荒谬地因为幻觉......有了那种反应。

对夏暮！怎么可能？！

甚至，这还是他记事以来，第一次当众失态。

这个念头，让他的太阳穴突突直跳。

真是疯了。

他转身，拿出手机，第一时间拨通了医生朋友的电话，“许卿，帮我安排脑部ct体检，现在就要！”

薄璟琛不知道的是，夏暮这边正在发生的一切，比他误以为是幻觉的，还要激烈。

与他各取所需？

听见霍宴年的话，夏暮愣神了半秒。

意识到他在说什么，她挣扎的动作停顿了一瞬。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Bo Jingchen's first reaction was to try to distance himself from the absurd touch.

But as his attention became less focused, those feelings became more intense.

In front of him, there was even a girl's cheek that was leaning towards him.

The hanging vines have long eyelashes with distinct roots.

These eyes were all too familiar to him.

It’s really Xia Mu!

How could that old-fashioned and boring woman kiss him so proactively?

He is really crazy, how could such a scene appear?!

"Jingchen? What's wrong with you? The reporter is waiting for your reply..." What brought him back to his senses was Su Ran's surprised exclamation.

Bo Jingchen's silence in front of such a question was like giving her a loud slap in the face in public!

But the next second, Bo Jingchen, who was distracted, made an unexpected move.

Without saying a word, he turned around and left.

The scene suddenly fell into uncontrollable chaos.

The host screamed and went to help Su Ran, while the photographer hurriedly adjusted the camera position.

The assistant rushed forward and blocked the live broadcast lens.

"Stop shooting!"

"Turn it off! Turn off the live broadcast!"

Su Ran was surrounded by several bodyguards and returned to the personal lounge.

Throughout the whole process, her eyes were red, but she still managed not to shed tears. She just stared at Bo Jingchen's back with an unbelievable look.

Bo Jingchen slammed the door of the lounge and stood there stupidly.

His fingertips were tightly clenched into fists, and he couldn't regain consciousness for a long time.

His ears were filled with the low gasping sound of the girl who had appeared automatically in his mind just now.

All the noise seemed to be isolated by a layer of barrier.

That feeling is only a short moment, fleeting.

But his heart felt as if someone had hit him hard, and it was so hot that he couldn't breathe.

Even though he hated to admit it, he couldn't deny it.

It was ridiculous for me to have such a reaction because of hallucinations.

To Xia Mu!How is it possible?!

In fact, this was the first time he had lost his temper in public since he could remember.

This thought made his temples pound.

It's crazy.

He turned around, took out his mobile phone, and immediately dialed the number of his doctor friend, "Xu Qing, help me arrange a brain CT examination. I need it now!"

What Bo Jingchen didn't know was that what was happening in Xia Mu was more intense than what he mistakenly thought was an illusion.

Get what you need with him?

Hearing Huo Yannian's words, Xia Mu was stunned for half a second.

Realizing what he was saying, her struggling movements paused for a moment.
